Maria Chen: Quick one — finalizing tomorrow's RFC review lineup. Need to lock authors, reviewer assignments, and run-of-show. Who's swapping or needs a different slot?

Chris K: I can cover the third slot if someone needs to move.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Tentative list: Anya (auth-sessions-v2), Samir (kv-cache-refactor), Lee (streaming-api-surface). If someone can't, call it out now.

Anya Rao: I can do auth-sessions. Can we put me first? I have a deps-blocker so would like earlier feedback. Also please post a short pre-read reminder to eng and product.

Lee Wong: First is fine with me. For the run-of-show, propose time boxes: quick context, 15m present + 10m QA per RFC. Keep canary reviewer notes to 5m.

Maria Chen: Proposed run-of-show:
```
18:00 - quick intros (5m)
18:05 - Anya — auth-sessions-v2 (15m + 10m QA)
18:30 - Samir — kv-cache-refactor (15m + 10m QA)
18:55 - Lee — streaming-api-surface (15m + 10m QA)
19:20 - wrap & action items (10m)
```
If everyone agrees I'll update the calendar.

Samir Patel: That timing works. Note: kv-cache has a small perf regression we want a reviewer to look at. @Chris K are you ok to focus on perf & rollout questions?

Chris K: Yep I can take perf/release questions for Samir. Also happy to jump in on Anya if we run over.

Anya Rao: Thanks — I've just pushed a short pre-read with highlights and a TL;DR at the top: https://redwood.internals/rfcs/auth-sessions-v2 — please skim. Highlights:
- migrate session store to kv-cache API
- edge-case token invalidation fix
- compat with existing session TTLs

Maria Chen: Great — can everyone react to this thread with :thumbsup: if they can make the meeting and :eyes: if they read pre-reads? I'll post a calendar update once we have confirmations.

Lee Wong: :thumbsup: I'll add a short demo clip for the streaming API slides to save time.

dev-bot: Reminder scheduled: post pre-read ping to #eng at 2 hours before meeting.

Maria Chen: Awesome. Action items:
- Maria: update calendar + attach run-of-show
- Anya/Samir/Lee: add 1-slide TL;DR to pre-read (due 24h before)
- Chris: perf reviewer for Samir

Maria Chen: If no objections, I'll lock this in at 11:30am PT today.

Chris K: sgtm

Samir Patel: sgtm

Anya Rao: sgtm

Lee Wong: sgtm

Maria Chen: Thanks all — closing thread and posting calendar update now.
